text: @guowenzhang/dsh-drawio 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的只读图表预览插件。它将 .drawio 文件接入侧边栏文档标签，在打开文件时读取完整内容，将普通 mxGraph XML 或 draw.io 的压缩编码解析为 XML，再调用图表渲染器生成可显示的图像。用户可以直接查看流程图，也可打开压缩保存的文件；渲染器按需加载，预览失败时界面提供重试入口。适合在 DSH 中查看设计图或流程图的用户。安装方式见 README；代码未声明额外 API Key 或外部账号。

@guowenzhang/dsh-drawio previews .drawio files as read-only diagrams in the DSH web sidebar. It decodes plain or compressed mxGraph XML and renders an image on open. The engine loads on demand; failed previews can be retried. The README gives installation instructions; no API key is declared.

打开 .drawio 文件时别只显示 XML 源码
I want to preview a draw.io diagram inside DSH.
@guowenzhang/dsh-drawio 的功能「侧边栏图表预览」：打开 .drawio 文档时在侧边栏文档标签显示只读图表。插件读取文件内容，解析普通 XML 或压缩编码，再交给渲染器绘制。
@guowenzhang/dsh-drawio 的功能「读取压缩图表」：打开采用 draw.io 默认压缩保存方式的文件时，将 Base64、raw-DEFLATE 和百分号编码还原为 mxGraph XML，再用于预览。
@guowenzhang/dsh-drawio 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 7 天；提交数 12；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

@guowenzhang/dsh-drawio README · Background: DeepSeek Harness：DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is the open-source agent harness from DeepSeek AI, where nearly every capability is a plugin on [Cordis](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis). It is in **developer preview** and iterating fast, so expect compatibility-breaking changes ([docs](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/), `0.1.7-alpha.*`); this plugin is a standalone third-party package that resolves `@deepseek-ai/*` from the running host.
@guowenzhang/dsh-drawio README · The problem this plugin solves：A `.drawio` file opens as mxGraph XML source; this plugin renders it as the diagram you drew, read-only, in the Web Sidebar.

@guowenzhang/dsh-drawio README · Screenshots：The capture is this repository's [`docs/example.drawio`](docs/example.drawio): `API gateway` → `Auth` → `Business logic`, with `read / write` on the edge down to `Database`.

@guowenzhang/dsh-drawio README · Install：```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add @guowenzhang/dsh-drawio
```

From the npm registry: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/@guowenzhang/dsh-drawio> — restart the host afterwards; local checkouts, git sources and troubleshooting are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

@guowenzhang/dsh-drawio README · Open a diagram：Opening a `.drawio` file from the file tree opens it in the Sidebar's document tab and renders it as a diagram, the way an image or a Markdown file opens. The engine that draws it is a separate, on-demand download — the plugin itself boots without it — so the first diagram shows a placeholder of the pane's own shape for a moment while the engine arrives, and a diagram the engine cannot lay out is reported in place with a **Retry**. Decoding and layout stay on the main thread, because the engine builds its SVG through the DOM; the image keeps the diagram's own aspect ratio, and the pane provides scrolling.

@guowenzhang/dsh-drawio README · See which save formats are readable：| Saved by draw.io as | What the file holds |
|---|---|
| Plain XML | mxGraph XML as text, greppable in a diff |
| Compressed (draw.io's default) | that same XML percent-escaped, raw-DEFLATE compressed, and base64 encoded |
section: See which save formats are readable

text: @guowenzhang/dsh-drawio README · Read a multi-page diagram：A multi-page `<mxfile>` renders its **first page**. The other pages stay in the file, untouched; open it in [dsh-drawioedit](https://github.com/zhang-guo-wen/dsh-drawioedit) or in draw.io to see them.

@guowenzhang/dsh-drawio README · Expect a preview, not an editor：The pane is read-only and inert. The file is decoded and laid out offscreen, and the pane receives a rendered SVG `data:` URL — never an engine instance or a live DOM — so a diagram's content cannot script the page. Editing needs [dsh-drawioedit](https://github.com/zhang-guo-wen/dsh-drawioedit); the two are independent packages, and either can be installed without the other.
section: Expect a preview, not an editor

text:
@guowenzhang/dsh-drawio README · Notes and caveats：**Edge routing and edge-label placement do not match draw.io.** A `.drawio` file stores an edge's endpoints and its `edgeStyle` name, but not the path between them:

```xml
<mxCell id="e4" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;…" edge="1" source="n4" target="n5">
  <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" />   <!-- no points, no label offset -->
</mxCell>
```

@guowenzhang/dsh-drawio README · Notes and caveats：Both viewers therefore compute the bend points and the label position at render time from the same inputs, with different code: draw.io's editor adds its own routing and label-avoidance behaviour on top of the shared engine, and this plugin's engine does not carry it. Where the gap between two nodes is narrower than the label — 50px apart, 66px label — the label cannot clear both boxes without moving a node, and an opaque background would only paint over the text it covers.

@guowenzhang/dsh-drawio README · Notes and caveats：**Workaround.** Drag the label where you want it in draw.io: the editor writes an explicit `<mxPoint as="offset">` into the file, which every viewer honours. Widening the gap between the two nodes works equally well. Both fix the diagram at its source rather than in one viewer.

**Shapes outside the bundled engine's set are drawn as plain rectangles**, never omitted: draw.io ships several hundred stencil shapes and the bundled engine carries a smaller set of its own.
